definitions.explanation: The practice of writing characters neatly, especially with brush and ink as taught in Japanese schools.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小学校|しょうがっこう}→小学校：01055_shougakkou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{習字|しゅうじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}った→習う：00479_narau⟧。
examples.english: I learned penmanship in elementary school.

examples.japanese: {習字|しゅうじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
⟦{娘|むすめ}→娘：02263_musume⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{習字|しゅうじ}⟦{教室|きょうしつ}→教室：00794_kyoushitsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}わせている→通う：01217_kayou⟧。
examples.english: I have my daughter attend calligraphy class.

notes:
SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{書道|しょどう}→書道：04178_shodou⟧ - calligraphy as an art form, more formal/artistic
- {習字|しゅうじ} - penmanship, learning to write properly (school subject)

{習字|しゅうじ} focuses on learning proper character formation, while ⟦{書道|しょどう}→書道：04178_shodou⟧ emphasizes artistic expression.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {習字|しゅうじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}う→習う：00479_narau⟧ (to learn penmanship)
- {習字|しゅうじ}⟦{教室|きょうしつ}→教室：00794_kyoushitsu⟧ (penmanship/calligraphy class)
- {習字|しゅうじ}⟦{道具|どうぐ}→道具：01479_dougu⟧ (calligraphy tools)
- {習字|しゅうじ}⟦セット→セット：03853_setto⟧ (calligraphy set)
